source.doc_type: Reviewed condensed consolidated and separate interim financial statements 1Q2025 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (3 months to 31 March 2025 = year to date). First IFRS 17 interim year (2567 comparatives restated). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). Reviewed, not audited (Deloitte). Thousand Baht. The SCI (p.6) has consolidated and separate columns; the separate columns are used (owner decision). Its tax line, labelled 'expense (income)', prints a credit in brackets this quarter (profit before tax + credit = net profit); it is stored as a credit (+). Note 21.1 is printed separately for the consolidated and the separate statements; the separate 2568 table is used (revenue and expenses p.94, reinsurance p.95; columns GMM 7.1 / PAA 7.2 / VFA 7.3 / total); expenses are printed positive (turned negative). The RA release is negative this quarter ((17,682); the GMM roll-forward also shows the RA for expired risk rising): recorded as printed. CSM roll-forward = GMM (p.56, closing p.57) + VFA (p.73; its closing rows are labelled 31 ธันวาคม but the column header is 31 มีนาคม 2568), CSM columns; new business = GMM p.59 + VFA p.75 totals. Each summed item records the GMM page. Future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment. VFA accretion is nil. Other expense = other operating expenses (other finance costs nil). In Q1 the three-month profit or loss is the year-to-date column.
